repos_data.description: MCP Server for Web Accessibility Testing (10k+ Downloads, #20 on ProductHunt)
MCP server for wcagc — let Claude or ChatGPT run real axe-core accessibility scans (WCAG, EN 301 549, PDF/UA) through your own account.
Accessibility engine for automated Web UI testing
Screen-reader navigation cost analyzer — models the real effort to discover, reach, and operate interactive web content

Color-computation server on the Model Context Protocol. Nine deterministic tools for conversion, harmony, mixing, WCAG contrast, and CIEDE2000. Published to the official MCP registry and listed in awesome-mcp-servers. Also an OAuth 2.1 resource server with RFC 9728 metadata and enforced per-tool scopes.

Verifies & compiles reduced-motion-safe, on-budget UI animation for AI-generated web apps. Validated specs → deterministic GSAP/WAAPI-CSS; WCAG 2.2.2 + 2.3.3 checks. MIT core + keyless MCP server. Not Motion.dev/Framer Motion, not the Android/iOS MotionSpec classes, not a video generator.
MCP server with 55 security intelligence tools — CVE/KEV, MITRE ATLAS+D3FEND, Sigma detection rules, email security posture (SPF/DMARC), domain & web intel, threat intel.
MCP EU AI Act Compliance Scanner - Open source tool to detect EU AI Act violations in codebases
Agent Skills for optimizing web quality based on Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals.
mcp server exposing regulated-industry AI compliance knowledge — EU AI Act · APRA · NIST AI RMF · ISO 42001 · AU AI Safety │  Standard. 6 tools · 53 resources · 5 prompts. Apache 2.0.
MCP server client examples for EasyAccessPDF — PDF accessibility (PDF/UA, WCAG) checks, auto-fix and document conversion from AI clients. Docs in EN/DE/FR/ES/JA.

Image provenance for AI agents: the ChronoVerify MCP server. Verify a photo's capture time and provenance (C2PA validation, EXIF/XMP, pixel forensics). Tools: verify_image (typed verdict) and get_signed_report. Local via npx, or hosted at chronoverify.com/mcp/http.

repo_meta_data.description: MCP server + CLI for WCAG 2.2 accessibility: contrast (pairs & text-over-image), EU accessibility declarations (RD 1112/2018 · Ley 11/2023 · EAA), aria-live monitor. Multilanguage es/en · zero dependencies
